about: Log 416 held-out set (G2: open choices of result). Written 2026-10-12 before any run of either arm; English only. `options`: words each option of the open choice must be named by (case-insensitive, any one alternative per option). `unsupported`: the index of an option no registered workflow gives. Families: OC open choice, every option supported and leading to different workflows; ON open choice with one unsupported option; OP choice within one workflow (a parameter or two results of the same workflow); OR open choice phrased as a run (report only); XC decided requests with uncertainty or hypothesis words about something else; XM methods questions naming workflows; XD plain decided requests.

items.prompt: We profiled 60 lung tumors by RNA-seq. We cannot decide whether to look at TF activity in each tumor or at the TF-gene network of each tumor.
